title: Deliverator: Zombie Delivery
author: EdgarDruin
selftext:
Seems I misunderstood playgama's first weekly challenge and took my time working on something that's sorta fun to play within an open world "city" theme.  Of course, they picked a space game, totally a city theme, and the 7 days included the time you needed to get to 100 plays, so uh, yah, maybe someone here will enjoy it along with my two nephews that play tested the early builds!

This started as a huge prompt passed into Codex as a /goal for astra.  After a few days iterating with codex, Opus 5.5 was released and I finished up more of the polish with it instead.

It's based on Kenney assets for the most part, elevenlabs for sound effects and a bit of blender through its mcp.

[https://playgama.ai/play/3vvugvw35d](https://playgama.ai/play/3vvugvw35d)

  
I enjoy tinkering on these while I work on bigger projects, but I'll have to try and pick up the pace for their next weekly contest. :)
